title: Flamenco Classes
description:
Date: Thursday, December 11, 2025
Time: 5:00pm - 6:00pm
Presenter: Natallia Basava
Location: PGML-Biblioteca Criolla

Discover Flamenco!
Join us for a dynamic and engaging Flamenco dance class where you'll learn the essential techniques of this passionate and vibrant dance form! This class will focus on fundamental exercises to help you master footwork, body posture, and hand and arm movements.

Whether you're a complete beginner or have some dance experience, no prior dance background is required—everyone is welcome! Classes are open to adults and children ages 9 and up.

THESE CLASSES ARE THE PART OF "INVITATION TO FLAMENCO" PROGRAM, SUPPORTED BY PUBLIC FUNDS FROM THE JERSEY CITY ARTS AND CULTURE TRUST FUND

Bilingual instruction will be provided in both English and Spanish to ensure everyone feels comfortable learning.

Classes will be taught by the talented instructor, Natallia Basava.

Every Thursdays

At Biblioteca Criolla (4th Fl) in the PG Main Library

Time: 4:00pm - 4:45pm
Presenter: Ms. Diana
Location: PGML-Biblioteca Criolla

¡Vamos a aprender español!
Spanish for Kids (Ages 7–10)

Learning a new language is easier—and more fun—when you're young! In this interactive and playful program, children will explore the basics of Spanish through songs, games, stories, and group activities. Guided by a caring and experienced teacher, kids will learn alongside peers in a supportive environment that encourages curiosity and confidence.

Whether it's saying hello in Spanish, counting to ten, or talking about their favorite animals, children will build foundational language skills while having a great time!

Instructor: Ms. Diana

title: Decorate a Snowman Contest
description:
Date: Monday, January 5, 2026
Time: 12:30pm - 7:30pm
Presenter: Tyara Tucker
Location: Pavonia Branch

Showoff YOUR Creativity at Pavonia Branch’s Snowman Contest! 

How to Enter:

  • Pick up a snowman template at the Pavonia Branch Library.
  • Get creative! You can use crayons, markers, glitter—anything you like. Remember, the most elaborate snowman won’t automatically win. We’re giving big points for personality and creativity!
  • Name your snowman. The name will be judged along with your artwork, so choose one that fits your snowman’s look and personality.
  • Submit your entry. When you’re finished, drop off your snowman and give it to any staff member at the Pavonia Branch. Please include your name, grade level, age, and contact information on the back. Deadline: All entries must be submitted by Friday, January 23. We will select two winners.
  • Winners will be notified, and all entries will be displayed in the library on Friday, January 30.

Prizes will be awarded for:

  • Most Creative
  • Winners will receive a special prize and library swag. 

For more info email pavoniabranch@jclibrary.org or call us at (201) 547-4808.

title: Little Mover's Storytime
description:
Date: Thursday, December 11, 2025
Time: 11:00am - 12:00pm
Location: Five Corners Branch- Multipurpose Space (Foyer), Five Corners Branch- William J. Timney Room, Five Corners Branch- Mildred Hunke Auditorium

Join us for songs, fingerplays, and of course, books! This is a special time to bond with your little one and meet other caregivers. We will explore the joys of books, songs, and gentle movement in addition to building early learning skills you can practice at home. Come prepared to sit with your child on your lap. Best for children who are pre-walkers.

 

Registration is required and opens 24 hours early (Mondays at 11:00am)
